pattern: styles, one sheet per part, beside the part; the same selectors in the same `@layer decks.surface`, so the layer decides the order, not the files
note: The parts named by the map, by what each rule styles: the card editor's words (`cards/card-editor.css`) and its bar, menus and dragged pieces (`cards/card-editor-bar.css`), the media player, the bar over a card (`chrome/bar.css`), the drawn overlay (`.world > .pen-*`), apps and documents, and cards; `view/canvas.css` keeps `.stage*`, `.world` and the engine's own layers. Each sheet opens `@layer decks.surface {`, counted in its lines. `harness/page/index.css` imports each new sheet where it imported `canvas.css`, in the same place, and `cascade-order.json` is regenerated.
